How to connect, what to do when it doesn\'t, and every feature in short

Tap the big Super-fast connect (WARP) button on the home screen: it needs no config. Or tap Quick connect to use Netino\'s free list. When Android asks to allow the VPN, tap OK. If you have your own config or subscription, add it with the + button on the Servers tab.

• The round button connects to the server shown in the card below it (tap the card to pick another).\n• Quick connect tests every server in the chosen scope (all, a subscription or a group, the small button next to it) and connects to the best ones in auto mode.\n• Super-fast connect uses WARP: no config needed, and it works on most networks.
How do I add a config or subscription?

On the Servers tab tap +:
• Paste from clipboard: links (vless, vmess, trojan, ss, hysteria2, wireguard), several at once, a base64 list or Xray / sing-box JSON.
• Scan a QR code, or pick a QR screenshot from the gallery.
• WireGuard / config files (.conf, .zip, .txt).
• Add subscription: the panel link (https or http).
Links and files shared from Telegram or a file manager open directly in Netino.
It doesn\'t connect. What should I do?

In this order:
1. Tap Quick connect: it tests everything and skips dead servers.
2. Try Super-fast connect (WARP).
3. Settings → Anti-censorship → Cloudflare path: run the check again (it picks ECH / IPv6 / F&F for this network).
4. Set TLS fragmentation to Auto or Always, and scan for a clean IP.
5. Switch between Wi-Fi and mobile data: firewalls differ.
If it still fails, send the network report (Usage tab) to whoever helps you.
What are WARP and WARP in WARP?

WARP is Cloudflare\'s free VPN; Netino makes the account and finds WARP addresses that work on your network. WARP in WARP runs a second WARP inside the first, so the firewall only sees the outer one: it gets through stricter networks. You can add a WARP+ key in the WARP section.
A site doesn\'t open or shows a captcha

• Iranian sites (banks, shops): turn on Settings → Routing and sharing → Iranian sites direct.\n• Google captchas, ChatGPT, Claude, Spotify, Netflix: set Exit through WARP to Some sites. Traffic then leaves with a Cloudflare IP these sites accept (needs one saved WARP server).
How do I use the VPN on my laptop or TV?

Turn on Settings → Routing and sharing → Share with other devices and connect the VPN. Connect the laptop to the phone\'s hotspot (or the same Wi-Fi), then enter the address shown there as the proxy: SOCKS5 port 10808 or HTTP port 10809, with the user and password shown.

Tap Quick connect: auto mode spreads traffic over the best few and moves away from a slow one by itself. Turn on Iranian sites direct so domestic traffic doesn\'t go abroad. On WireGuard / WARP, if pages load half-way, set WireGuard MTU to 1280.
How do I keep it always on?

Settings → Privacy and security → Kill switch opens Android\'s VPN settings: turn on Always-on VPN for Netino and Block connections without VPN. Then nothing leaves the phone outside the VPN. The quick tile and the home-screen widget connect in one tap; Auto-connect for apps turns it on when chosen apps open.

Your servers and settings are stored encrypted on this phone only; Netino has no account and no servers that see your traffic. App lock asks for your fingerprint or screen lock. Hold the Netino icon and choose Panic wipe to erase everything at once. Backups are encrypted with a password you choose.
How do I send a report for help?
Usage tab → Network report: it shows what worked on each network (firewall check, WARP, scans). Copy or share it. Below it, Copy report adds the live log. Neither contains your configs or keys.

Connecting when only Iranian sites work, and getting ready for it

Netino can send, once a day, which free configs worked on your network: a short code for each config and whether it connected, nothing else (no IP, phone number or browsing). The service only reads which operator the connection comes from, so people on the same operator get the working configs first. You can change this in Settings → Privacy.
